name: sale-simulator
description: # Sales Simulator — Distributed Traffic Management System
author: chufeebanhton
main: The project aims to explore how a web application can be designed to accommodate **10,000–30,000 concurrent users**, while measuring request throughput, response latency, error rates, resource utilization, and the impact of external API limitations.

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start:server
